function.name: Movies_3_FindMovies
function.description: Search for movies based on specific criteria such as director, genre, and cast. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

directed_by.description: The director of the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the director is not a search criterion.

genre.description: The genre of the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the genre is not a search criterion.

cast.description: The lead actor in the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the cast is not a search criterion.

function.name: Music_3_PlayMedia
function.description: Plays the selected music track on the specified device. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

track.description: The title of the song to be played.

artist.description: The name of the artist performing the song.

device.description: The device where the music will be played. Choose from a list of available players.

album.description: The name of the album that the song belongs to.

function.name: Music_3_LookupMusic
function.description: Discover songs that match your music preferences, such as artist, album, genre, and release year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artist.description: The name of the performer or band. Use 'dontcare' to ignore this filter.

album.description: The name of the album containing the song. Use 'dontcare' to ignore this filter.

genre.description: The musical style or category of the song. Use 'dontcare' for no preference.

year.description: The year the song was released. Format: 'YYYY'. Use 'dontcare' to ignore this filter.
